ucs.title: [LLM] Lazarus / Diamond Sleet — DLL side-loading via legit signed binary executing from user-writable path (Operation Dream Job kit)
ucs.description: Hunts the Lazarus 'Dream Job' / 'Interception' delivery chain where an ISO/ZIP drops a legitimate signed binary (Amazon VNC, CameraSettingsUIHost, EhStorAuthn, IViewers, CiscoCollabHost, mscoree, etc.) alongside a malicious DLL of the same name, then runs the binary from Downloads/Temp/AppData so it side-loads the planted DLL. This is the signature install vector Mandiant, Microsoft (Diamond Sleet/ZINC), and CrowdStrike (Labyrinth Chollima) all attribute to Lazarus across the 3CX, defense, aerospace and crypto-exchange intrusions.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.process_name IN ("AmazonVNCService.exe","CameraSettingsUIHost.exe","EhStorAuthn.exe","IViewers.exe","WidgetService.exe","colorcpl.exe","mscoree.exe","CiscoCollabHost.exe","LeoUI.exe","wsmprovhost.exe") AND NOT (Processes.process_path IN ("*\\Program Files\\*","*\\Program Files (x86)\\*","*\\Windows\\*","*\\WindowsApps\\*")) AND NOT Processes.user IN ("*$","SYSTEM","LOCAL SERVICE","NETWORK SERVICE")) by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.parent_process_name Processes.parent_process_path Processes.process_name Processes.process_path Processes.process Processes.process_hash | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | rex field=process_path "(?i)(?<dropdir>downloads|temp|appdata|public|programdata|users\\\\public)" | where isnotnull(dropdir) | `security_content_ctime(firstTime)` | `security_content_ctime(lastTime)`
ucs.kql:
// Lazarus side-loading kit — Microsoft-signed binary running from user-writable path then loading a sibling DLL
let SideLoadHosts = dynamic([
    "amazonvncservice.exe","camerasettingsuihost.exe","ehstorauthn.exe",
    "iviewers.exe","widgetservice.exe","colorcpl.exe","mscoree.exe",
    "ciscocollabhost.exe","leoui.exe","wsmprovhost.exe"
]);
let Procs = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(30d)
    | where tolower(FileName) in (SideLoadHosts)
    | where FolderPath !startswith @"C:\Program Files"
        and FolderPath !startswith @"C:\Program Files (x86)"
        and FolderPath !startswith @"C:\Windows"
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"      // exclude machine accounts
    | project Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName, ProcessId,
              ProcFile = FileName, ProcFolder = FolderPath,
              ProcCmd = ProcessCommandLine, ProcSHA = SHA256;
Procs
| join kind=inner (
    DeviceImageLoadEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(30d)
    | where FileName endswith ".dll"
    | project DllTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, InitiatingProcessId,
              DllName = FileName, DllFolder = FolderPath, DllSHA = SHA256
  ) on DeviceId, $left.ProcessId == $right.InitiatingProcessId
| where DllFolder =~ ProcFolder            // sibling DLL = classic side-load layout
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, ProcFile, ProcFolder, ProcCmd,
          ProcSHA, DllName, DllSHA, DllTime
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
// Lazarus side-loading kit — 4688 process-create from non-standard folder for known abused signed binaries
let SideLoadHosts = dynamic([
    "amazonvncservice.exe","camerasettingsuihost.exe","ehstorauthn.exe",
    "iviewers.exe","widgetservice.exe","colorcpl.exe","mscoree.exe",
    "ciscocollabhost.exe","leoui.exe","wsmprovhost.exe"
]);
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| where EventID == 4688
| extend ProcName = tolower(tostring(split(NewProcessName, "\\")[-1]))
| where ProcName in (SideLoadHosts)
| where NewProcessName !startswith @"C:\Program Files"
    and NewProcessName !startswith @"C:\Program Files (x86)"
    and NewProcessName !startswith @"C:\Windows"
| where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
| extend DropDir = extract(@"(?i)\\(Downloads|Temp|AppData|Public|ProgramData|Users\\Public)\\", 1, NewProcessName)
| where isnotempty(DropDir)
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, SubjectUserName, NewProcessName, CommandLine, ParentProcessName, DropDir
| order by TimeGenerated desc

ucs.title: [LLM] Lazarus 'Contagious Interview' / DEV#POPPER — node.exe spawning LOLBin egress within minutes of npm install (BeaverTail → InvisibleFerret)
ucs.description: Hunts the Lazarus developer-targeting campaign tracked as Contagious Interview (Palo Alto Unit 42) / DEV#POPPER (Securonix) / Hidden Cobra recruiter lures where a fake recruiter pushes a trojanized npm package or coding-test repo; npm install triggers node.exe to spawn curl/powershell/cmd to fetch the InvisibleFerret Python second-stage from attacker infra (often .ipcheck.cloud, npmaudit.*, *.ngrok-free.app, *.workers.dev). Catches the early-stage BeaverTail JavaScript stealer before InvisibleFerret persistence lands.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.parent_process_name IN ("node.exe","python.exe","pythonw.exe") AND Processes.process_name IN ("curl.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","certutil.exe","cmd.exe","wget.exe","bitsadmin.exe") AND (Processes.process="*Invoke-WebRequest*" OR Processes.process="*DownloadString*" OR Processes.process="*DownloadFile*" OR Processes.process="*-urlcache*" OR Processes.process="*curl*http*" OR Processes.process="*ipcheck*" OR Processes.process="*npmaudit*" OR Processes.process="*.ngrok*" OR Processes.process="*workers.dev*" OR Processes.process="*.npl*" OR Processes.process="*invisibleferret*" OR Processes.process="*beavertail*" OR Processes.process="*p.zi*")) by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.parent_process_name Processes.parent_process_path Processes.process_name Processes.process Processes.process_hash | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | `security_content_ctime(firstTime)` | `security_content_ctime(lastTime)`
ucs.kql:
// Lazarus Contagious Interview / DEV#POPPER — node.exe (or python.exe second-stage) launching a LOLBin to pull staging
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(14d)
| where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("node.exe","python.exe","pythonw.exe")
| where FileName in~ ("curl.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","certutil.exe","cmd.exe","wget.exe","bitsadmin.exe")
| where ProcessCommandLine has_any (
    "Invoke-WebRequest","DownloadString","DownloadFile","-urlcache","curl http","curl -",
    "ipcheck","npmaudit","ngrok","workers.dev","trycloudflare",
    ".npl",".n2",".pyp","invisibleferret","beavertail","p.zi"
  )
  or ProcessCommandLine matches regex @"(?i)https?://(?:\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}(?::\d+)?/"
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| where InitiatingProcessParentFileName !in~ ("vscode.exe","Code.exe","WebStorm64.exe","idea64.exe")     // optional: scope out IDE-driven legit dev work via comment-out
      or ProcessCommandLine has_any ("ipcheck","npmaudit",".npl","invisibleferret")                    // unless IOC tokens present
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName,
          ParentProcess = InitiatingProcessFileName, ParentCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          ChildProcess = FileName, ChildCmd = ProcessCommandLine, SHA256
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
// Lazarus Contagious Interview — Sentinel SecurityEvent 4688 equivalent
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(14d)
| where EventID == 4688
| extend ParentName = tolower(tostring(split(ParentProcessName, "\\")[-1]))
| extend ChildName  = tolower(tostring(split(NewProcessName, "\\")[-1]))
| where ParentName in ("node.exe","python.exe","pythonw.exe")
| where ChildName  in ("curl.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","certutil.exe","cmd.exe","wget.exe","bitsadmin.exe")
| where CommandLine has_any (
    "Invoke-WebRequest","DownloadString","DownloadFile","-urlcache","curl http",
    "ipcheck","npmaudit","ngrok","workers.dev","trycloudflare",
    ".npl",".n2",".pyp","invisibleferret","beavertail","p.zi")
  or CommandLine matches regex @"(?i)https?://(?:\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}(?::\d+)?/"
| where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, SubjectUserName, ParentProcessName, NewProcessName, CommandLine
| order by TimeGenerated desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: Lazarus Contagious Interview - Node or Python Spawns Network LOLBin
id: 7c81e9b2-3a4f-49d1-bcd3-lazarus-devpopper
status: experimental
description: Detects node.exe / python.exe spawning curl, powershell, certutil, bitsadmin, wget, or cmd with download/HTTP-fetch arguments or known Contagious Interview / DEV#POPPER IOC tokens. Associated with Lazarus Group (DPRK) targeting of developers via trojanized npm packages and coding-interview lures (BeaverTail JS stealer dropping InvisibleFerret Python RAT).
references:
  - https://unit42.paloaltonetworks.com/two-campaigns-by-north-korea-bad-actors-target-job-hunters/
  - https://www.securonix.com/blog/analysis-of-dev-popper-new-attack-campaign-targeting-software-developers-likely-associated-with-north-korean-threat-actors/
  - https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0032/
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/16
tags:
  - attack.execution
  - attack.initial_access
  - attack.t1195.001
  - attack.t1059.007
  - attack.t1105
  - attack.g0032
logsource:
  product: windows
  category: process_creation
detection:
  selection_parent:
    ParentImage|endswith:
      - '\node.exe'
      - '\python.exe'
      - '\pythonw.exe'
  selection_child:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\curl.exe'
      - '\powershell.exe'
      - '\pwsh.exe'
      - '\certutil.exe'
      - '\cmd.exe'
      - '\wget.exe'
      - '\bitsadmin.exe'
  selection_cmd:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'Invoke-WebRequest'
      - 'DownloadString'
      - 'DownloadFile'
      - '-urlcache'
      - 'curl http'
      - 'ipcheck'
      - 'npmaudit'
      - 'ngrok'
      - 'workers.dev'
      - 'trycloudflare'
      - '.npl'
      - 'invisibleferret'
      - 'beavertail'
      - 'p.zi'
  condition: selection_parent and selection_child and selection_cmd
falsepositives:
  - Build scripts that legitimately fetch tooling via curl/powershell (filter on InitiatingProcessParent = vscode/Code/idea once tuned per environment)
level: high
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 @ParentImage:(*\\node.exe OR *\\NODE.EXE OR *\\python.exe OR *\\PYTHON.EXE OR *\\pythonw.exe OR *\\PYTHONW.EXE) AND @Image:(*\\curl.exe OR *\\CURL.EXE OR *\\powershell.exe OR *\\PowerShell.exe OR *\\POWERSHELL.EXE OR *\\pwsh.exe OR *\\PWSH.EXE OR *\\certutil.exe OR *\\CERTUTIL.EXE OR *\\cmd.exe OR *\\CMD.EXE OR *\\wget.exe OR *\\WGET.EXE OR *\\bitsadmin.exe OR *\\BITSADMIN.EXE) AND @CommandLine:(*Invoke-WebRequest* OR *DownloadString* OR *DownloadFile* OR *-urlcache* OR *ipcheck* OR *npmaudit* OR *ngrok* OR *workers.dev* OR *trycloudflare* OR *.npl* OR *invisibleferret* OR *beavertail* OR *p.zi*)
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 ParentBaseFileName=/(node|python|pythonw)\.exe$/i
| ImageFileName=/(curl|powershell|pwsh|certutil|cmd|wget|bitsadmin)\.exe$/i
| regex("(?i)(Invoke-WebRequest|DownloadString|DownloadFile|-urlcache|curl\\s+http|ipcheck|npmaudit|ngrok|workers\\.dev|trycloudflare|\\.npl|invisibleferret|beavertail|p\\.zi)", field=CommandLine)
| UserName!=/\$$/
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, ParentBaseFileName, ImageFileName, CommandLine], function=count())
| count >= 1
